**Zeteo** is gearing up to cover one of the most consequential midterm
elections in modern U.S. history, and we need all the support you can give.

It is going to be all hands on deck for team **Zeteo** on election night:
**Mehdi** and **Prem** will be live from Abdul El-Sayed HQ in Detroit,
Michigan from 9pm ET on Substack and YouTube; **Swin Suebsaeng** will be on
the ground covering the major races in Ohio (_hello Vivek Ramasawmy!_), and
**Andrew Perez** will be reporting on whether it is _finally_ game over for
Susan Collins in Maine.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

It takes a village to bring you the coverage we have planned on Tuesday night,
and we can't do it alone. **Zeteo** is 100% subscriber-funded, and to keep our
work independent, bold, and unfiltered, we look to you, our subscribers - not
corporate shareholders, billionaire owners, or algorithm games.

So if you're a free subscriber, please consider [upgrading to a
](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)**[paid
subscription](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)** this week, where you can unlock
all that **Zeteo** has to offer - from [in-depth
reporting](https://zeteo.com/p/stephen-miller-trump-running-world) to
[acclaimed](https://zeteo.com/p/watch-now-gaza-doctors-under-attack)
[documentaries](http://insideaipac.com).

You can also [support our work with a donation](https://donorbox.org/support-
zeteo). Even a little goes a long way.
